description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wattemulla, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510030 (23/0150)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and property details. The content is focused on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
